title: Action Images: End-to-End Policy Learning via Multiview Video Generation
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising direction for robot policy learning, as they can leverage powerful video backbones to model the future states. However, existing approaches often rely on separate action modules, or use action representations that are not pixel-grounded, making it difficult to fully exploit the pretrained knowledge of video models and limiting transfer across viewpoints and environments. In this work, we present Action Images, a unified world action model that formulates policy learning as multiview video generation. Instead of encoding control as low-dimensional tokens, we translate 7-DoF robot actions into interpretable action images: multi-view action videos that are grounded in 2D pixels and explicitly track robot-arm motion. This pixel-grounded action representation allows the video backbone itself to act as a zero-shot policy, without a separate policy head or action module. Beyond control, the same unified model supports video-action joint generation, action-conditioned video generation, and action labeling under a shared representation. On RLBench and real-world evaluations, our model achieves the strongest zero-shot success rates and improves video-action joint generation quality over prior video-space world models, suggesting that interpretable action images are a promising route to policy learning.
tldr: This paper introduces Action Images, a unified world action model that formulates robot policy learning as multi-view video generation, representing robot actions as interpretable, pixel-grounded action images.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Action Images，一种将机器人策略学习表述为多视角视频生成的统一世界动作模型，将机器人动作表示为可解释的、基于像素的动作图像。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为机器人策略学习的一个重要方向，其能够利用强大的视频骨干网络来建模未来状态。然而，现有方法往往依赖独立的动作模块，或采用非像素化的动作表示，这导致难以充分利用预训练视频模型的知识，并限制了跨视角与环境的迁移能力。本文提出"动作图像"——一种统一的世界动作模型，将策略学习定义为多视角视频生成任务。不同于将控制指令编码为低维标记，我们将7自由度机器人动作转化为可解释的动作图像：一种基于二维像素、并明确追踪机器人手臂运动的多视角动作视频。这种像素化的动作表示使得视频骨干网络本身能够作为零样本策略执行，无需独立的策略头部或动作模块。除控制任务外，同一统一模型还可在共享表征下支持视频-动作联合生成、动作条件视频生成及动作标注任务。在RLBench仿真环境与真实世界评估中，本模型取得了最优的零样本成功率，并超越了现有视频空间世界模型在视频-动作联合生成方面的性能，表明可解释的动作图像是策略学习的一条有效路径。

title: HiPolicy: Hierarchical Multi-Frequency Action Chunking for Policy Learning
summary: Robotic imitation learning faces a fundamental trade-off between modeling long-horizon dependencies and enabling fine-grained closed-loop control. Existing fixed-frequency action chunking approaches struggle to achieve both. Building on this insight, we propose HiPolicy, a hierarchical multi-frequency action chunking framework that jointly predicts action sequences at different frequencies to capture both coarse high-level plans and precise reactive motions. We extract and fuse hierarchical features from history observations aligned to each frequency for multi-frequency chunk generation, and introduce an entropy-guided execution mechanism that adaptively balances long-horizon planning with fine-grained control based on action uncertainty. Experiments on diverse simulated benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks show that HiPolicy can be seamlessly integrated into existing 2D and 3D generative policies, delivering consistent improvements in performance while significantly enhancing execution efficiency.
tldr: Proposes a hierarchical policy framework for robotic imitation learning that generates multi-frequency action sequences to balance long-horizon planning and fine-grained control.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于机器人模仿学习的分层策略框架，生成多频率动作序列以平衡长时程规划和精细闭环控制。
summary_zh: 机器人模仿学习面临着一个根本性的权衡：既要建模长时程依赖关系，又要实现细粒度的闭环控制。现有的固定频率动作分块方法难以兼顾两者。基于此洞察，我们提出HiPolicy——一种分层多频率动作分块框架，通过联合预测不同频率下的动作序列，既能捕捉粗粒度的宏观规划，又能实现精细的反应性动作。我们从与各频率对齐的历史观测中提取并融合分层特征以生成多频率动作块，并引入基于熵引导的执行机制，该机制可根据动作不确定性自适应地平衡长时程规划与细粒度控制。在多样化仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，HiPolicy能够无缝集成到现有的二维与三维生成策略中，在显著提升执行效率的同时，持续改善任务性能。

title: BiCoord: A Bimanual Manipulation Benchmark towards Long-Horizon Spatial-Temporal Coordination
summary: Bimanual manipulation, i.e., the coordinated use of two robotic arms to complete tasks, is essential for achieving human-level dexterity in robotics. Recent simulation benchmarks, e.g., RoboTwin and RLBench2, have advanced data-driven learning for bimanual manipulation. However, existing tasks are short-horizon and only loosely coordinated, failing to capture the spatial-temporal coupling inherent in real-world bimanual behaviors. To address this gap, we introduce BiCoord, a benchmark for long-horizon and tightly coordinated bimanual manipulation. Specifically, BiCoord comprises diverse tasks that require continuous inter-arm dependency and dynamic role exchange across multiple sub-goals. Also, we propose a suite of quantitative metrics that evaluate coordination from temporal, spatial, and spatial-temporal perspectives, enabling systematic measurement of bimanual cooperation. Experimental results show that representative manipulation policies, e.g., DP, RDT, Pi0, and OpenVLA-OFT, struggle with long-duration and highly coupled tasks, revealing fundamental challenges in achieving long-horizon and tight coordination tasks. We hope BiCoord can serve as a foundation for studying long-horizon cooperative manipulation and inspire future research on coordination-aware robotic learning. All datasets, codes and supplements could be found at https://buaa-colalab.github.io/BiCoord/.
tldr: The paper introduces BiCoord, a new benchmark for evaluating long-horizon and tightly coordinated bimanual manipulation tasks, highlighting challenges for current state-of-the-art robot learning policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BiCoord，一个用于评估长视程、紧密协调的双臂操作任务的新基准，揭示了当前先进机器人学习策略在此类任务中的挑战。
summary_zh: 双手操作（即协调使用两个机械臂完成任务）对于实现机器人达到人类灵巧水平至关重要。近期仿真基准（如RoboTwin和RLBench2）推动了数据驱动的双手操作学习。然而，现有任务多为短周期且协调松散，未能体现真实世界双手行为中固有的时空耦合特性。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了BiCoord——一个面向长周期、紧密协调的双手操作基准。具体而言，BiCoord包含多种任务，这些任务要求机械臂在多个子目标间保持持续的臂间依赖性和动态角色交换。同时，我们提出了一套从时间、空间及时空维度评估协调性的量化指标，从而实现对双手协作的系统化测量。实验结果表明，代表性操作策略（如DP、RDT、Pi0和OpenVLA-OFT）在长周期、高耦合任务中表现不佳，揭示了实现长周期紧密协调任务的根本性挑战。我们希望BiCoord能为研究长周期协作操作提供基础，并启发未来对协调感知机器人学习的探索。所有数据集、代码及补充材料可通过https://buaa-colalab.github.io/BiCoord/获取。

title: A1: A Fully Transparent Open-Source, Adaptive and Efficient Truncated Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for open-world robot manipulation, but their practical deployment is often constrained by cost: billion-scale VLM backbones and iterative diffusion/flow-based action heads incur high latency and compute, making real-time control expensive on commodity hardware. We present A1, a fully open-source and transparent VLA framework designed for low-cost, high-throughput inference without sacrificing manipulation success; Our approach leverages pretrained VLMs that provide implicit affordance priors for action generation. We release the full training stack (training code, data/data-processing pipeline, intermediate checkpoints, and evaluation scripts) to enable end-to-end reproducibility. Beyond optimizing the VLM alone, A1 targets the full inference pipeline by introducing a budget-aware adaptive inference scheme that jointly accelerates the backbone and the action head. Specifically, we monitor action consistency across intermediate VLM layers to trigger early termination, and propose Inter-Layer Truncated Flow Matching that warm-starts denoising across layers, enabling accurate actions with substantially fewer effective denoising iterations. Across simulation benchmarks (LIBERO, VLABench) and real robots (Franka, AgiBot), A1 achieves state-of-the-art success rates while significantly reducing inference cost (e.g., up to 72% lower per-episode latency for flow-matching inference and up to 76.6% backbone computation reduction with minor performance degradation). On RoboChallenge, A1 achieves an average success rate of 29.00%, outperforming baselines including pi0(28.33%), X-VLA (21.33%), and RDT-1B (15.00%).
tldr: A1 is an open-source Vision-Language-Action model for robot manipulation that introduces adaptive inference and truncated flow matching to reduce latency and computational cost while maintaining high performance.
tldr_zh: A1 是一个用于机器人操作的开放源码视觉语言动作模型，它引入了自适应推理和截断流匹配技术，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了延迟和计算成本。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型已成为开放世界机器人操控的强大范式，但其实际部署常受成本限制：十亿级视觉语言模型骨干与基于迭代扩散或流的动作头部会引发高延迟与计算负担，导致在普通硬件上实现实时控制成本高昂。本文提出A1——一个完全开源透明的视觉-语言-动作框架，旨在实现低成本、高吞吐量推理且不牺牲操控成功率。该方法利用预训练视觉语言模型提供的隐式可供性先验进行动作生成，并发布了完整训练框架（训练代码、数据与数据处理流程、中间检查点及评估脚本），以实现端到端可复现性。A1不仅优化视觉语言模型，更通过引入预算感知的自适应推理机制协同加速骨干网络与动作头部：通过监控中间层动作一致性触发早期终止，并提出层间截断流匹配技术实现跨层去噪预热，从而以显著更少的有效去噪迭代生成精确动作。在仿真基准测试与实体机器人实验中，A1在显著降低推理成本的同时达到最优成功率（流匹配推理每幕延迟降低最高达72%，骨干网络计算量减少最高达76.6%且性能损失微小）。在RoboChallenge评测中，A1以29.00%的平均成功率超越包括pi0、X-VLA及RDT-1B在内的基线模型。

title: Grounding Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Models Through Explicit Language-Action Alignment
summary: Achieving robot transparency is a critical step toward effective human-robot collaboration. To be transparent, a robot's natural language communication must be consistent with its actions and explicitly grounded in the task and environment. Existing hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can generate language (e.g., through chain-of-thought) and low-level actions. However, current work does not consider explicit alignment between these modalities during training. To address this crucial gap, we propose a novel training framework that explicitly grounds hierarchical VLA sub-task descriptions with respect to the visual observation and action space. Our framework uses a contrastive model to assess the alignment between generated language and corresponding action trajectories. This contrastive model enables direct ranking of different language-trajectory pairs based on their alignment, allowing us to refine the grounding of our hierarchical VLA through offline preference learning. We apply our framework to the LanguageTable dataset, a benchmark dataset of human language-annotated trajectories, and provide critical insights into multimodal grounding representations, all while establishing a strong baseline that achieves performance comparable to fully supervised fine-tuning and minimizing the need for costly data annotations.
tldr: The paper proposes a training framework for hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that explicitly aligns generated language sub-task descriptions with robot action trajectories using a contrastive model and offline preference learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层视觉-语言-动作模型训练框架，通过对比模型和离线偏好学习，显式地将生成的语言子任务描述与机器人动作轨迹对齐。
summary_zh: 实现机器人透明化是迈向有效人机协作的关键一步。为达到透明化，机器人的自然语言通信必须与其行为保持一致，并明确基于任务和环境进行定位。现有的分层视觉-语言-动作模型能够生成语言（如通过思维链）及低层动作，但当前研究未在训练期间考虑这些模态间的显式对齐。为解决这一关键缺口，我们提出了一种新颖的训练框架，该框架将分层视觉-语言-动作模型的子任务描述明确地锚定于视觉观察和动作空间。我们的框架采用对比模型来评估生成语言与相应动作轨迹之间的对齐程度，此对比模型可直接基于对齐性对不同语言-轨迹对进行排序，从而通过离线偏好学习优化分层视觉-语言-动作模型的定位能力。我们将该框架应用于LanguageTable数据集——一个包含人类语言标注轨迹的基准数据集，不仅为多模态定位表征提供了关键见解，同时建立了性能可比肩全监督微调的强基线，并显著减少了对高成本数据标注的需求。

title: Uncovering Linguistic Fragility in Vision-Language-Action Models via Diversity-Aware Red Teaming
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable success in robotic manipulation. However, their robustness to linguistic nuances remains a critical, under-explored safety concern, posing a significant safety risk to real-world deployment. Red teaming, or identifying environmental scenarios that elicit catastrophic behaviors, is an important step in ensuring the safe deployment of embodied AI agents. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach in automated red teaming that aims to uncover these vulnerabilities. However, standard RL-based adversaries often suffer from severe mode collapse due to their reward-maximizing nature, which tends to converge to a narrow set of trivial or repetitive failure patterns, failing to reveal the comprehensive landscape of meaningful risks. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel \textbf{D}iversity-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{E}mbodied \textbf{R}ed \textbf{T}eaming (\textbf{DAERT}) framework, to expose the vulnerabilities of VLAs against linguistic variations. Our design is based on evaluating a uniform policy, which is able to generate a diverse set of challenging instructions while ensuring its attack effectiveness, measured by execution failures in a physical simulator. We conduct extensive experiments across different robotic benchmarks against two state-of-the-art VLAs, including $π_0$ and OpenVLA. Our method consistently discovers a wider range of more effective adversarial instructions that reduce the average task success rate from 93.33\% to 5.85\%, demonstrating a scalable approach to stress-testing VLA agents and exposing critical safety blind spots before real-world deployment.
tldr: Proposes a diversity-aware red teaming framework (DAERT) to expose vulnerabilities in Vision-Language-Action models for robot manipulation by generating diverse, effective adversarial instructions that cause execution failures in physical simulation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种多样性感知的红队测试框架（DAERT），通过在物理模拟中生成多样且有效的对抗性指令，来暴露用于机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作模型的脆弱性，导致执行失败。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操控领域取得了显著成功。然而，其对语言细微差异的鲁棒性仍是一个关键且未被充分探索的安全问题，这给实际部署带来了重大安全风险。红队测试——即识别可能引发灾难性行为的环境场景——是确保具身智能体安全部署的重要环节。强化学习已成为自动化红队测试中一种颇具前景的方法，旨在揭示这些潜在漏洞。然而，基于强化学习的标准对抗方法因其奖励最大化的特性，常陷入严重的模式坍塌，倾向于收敛到少量简单或重复的故障模式，无法全面揭示有意义风险的完整图谱。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种新颖的**多样性感知具身红队测试框架**，以揭示视觉-语言-动作模型面对语言变异的脆弱性。该框架设计基于对均匀策略的评估，能够生成多样化高难度指令集，同时确保其攻击有效性（通过物理模拟器中的执行失败率衡量）。我们在多个机器人基准测试中对两种前沿视觉-语言-动作模型（包括$π_0$和OpenVLA）进行了广泛实验。本方法持续发现更广泛且更有效的对抗性指令，将平均任务成功率从93.33%降至5.85%，证明了这种压力测试视觉-语言-动作模型的可扩展方法，能在实际部署前暴露关键的安全盲区。

title: JailWAM: Jailbreaking World Action Models in Robot Control
summary: The World Action Model (WAM) can jointly predict future world states and actions, exhibiting stronger physical manipulation capabilities compared with traditional models. Such powerful physical interaction ability is a double-edged sword: if safety is ignored, it will directly threaten personal safety, property security and environmental safety. However, existing research pays extremely limited attention to the critical security gap: the vulnerability of WAM to jailbreak attacks. To fill this gap, we define the Three-Level Safety Classification Framework to systematically quantify the safety of robotic arm motions. Furthermore, we propose JailWAM, the first dedicated jailbreak attack and evaluation framework for WAM, which consists of three core components: (1) Visual-Trajectory Mapping, which unifies heterogeneous action spaces into visual trajectory representations and enables cross-architectural unified evaluation; (2) Risk Discriminator, which serves as a high-recall screening tool that optimizes the efficiency-accuracy trade-off when identifying destructive behaviors in visual trajectories; (3) Dual-Path Verification Strategy, which first conducts rapid coarse screening via a single-image-based video-action generation module, and then performs efficient and comprehensive verification through full closed-loop physical simulation. In addition, we construct JailWAM-Bench, a benchmark for comprehensively evaluating the safety alignment performance of WAM under jailbreak attacks. Experiments in RoboTwin simulation environment demonstrate that the proposed framework efficiently exposes physical vulnerabilities, achieving an 84.2% attack success rate on the state-of-the-art LingBot-VA. Meanwhile, robust defense mechanisms can be constructed based on JailWAM, providing an effective technical solution for designing safe and reliable robot control systems.
tldr: This paper introduces JailWAM, the first dedicated jailbreak attack and evaluation framework for World Action Models (WAMs) in robot control, proposing a safety classification system and a benchmark to assess and improve the safety of robotic manipulation systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出JailWAM，首个针对机器人控制中世界行动模型（WAM）的越狱攻击与评估框架，包括安全分级系统和基准测试，以评估和提升机器人操作系统的安全性。
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAM）能够联合预测未来世界状态与行动，展现出较传统模型更强的物理操控能力。如此强大的物理交互能力犹如双刃剑：若忽视安全性，将直接威胁人身安全、财产安全及环境安全。然而现有研究对关键安全缺口——WAM面临越狱攻击的脆弱性——的关注极为有限。为填补这一空白，本文定义三级安全分类框架，系统量化机械臂运动的安全性。进一步提出首个面向WAM的专用越狱攻击与评估框架JailWAM，该框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 视觉轨迹映射，将异构动作空间统一为视觉轨迹表示，实现跨架构的统一评估；(2) 风险判别器，作为高召回率筛选工具，在识别视觉轨迹中的破坏性行为时优化效率与准确性的权衡；(3) 双路径验证策略，先通过基于单帧图像的视频动作生成模块进行快速粗筛，再通过全闭环物理仿真实施高效全面的验证。此外，我们构建了JailWAM-Bench基准测试集，用于全面评估WAM在越狱攻击下的安全对齐性能。在RoboTwin仿真环境中的实验表明，所提框架能高效暴露物理脆弱性，在尖端模型LingBot-VA上实现84.2%的攻击成功率。同时基于JailWAM可构建鲁棒的防御机制，为设计安全可靠的机器人控制系统提供有效的技术方案。

title: CoEnv: Driving Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration via Compositional Environment
summary: Multi-agent embodied systems hold promise for complex collaborative manipulation, yet face critical challenges in spatial coordination, temporal reasoning, and shared workspace awareness. Inspired by human collaboration where cognitive planning occurs separately from physical execution, we introduce the concept of compositional environment -- a synergistic integration of real-world and simulation components that enables multiple robotic agents to perceive intentions and operate within a unified decision-making space. Building on this concept, we present CoEnv, a framework that leverages simulation for safe strategy exploration while ensuring reliable real-world deployment. CoEnv operates through three stages: real-to-sim scene reconstruction that digitizes physical workspaces, VLM-driven action synthesis supporting both real-time planning with high-level interfaces and iterative planning with code-based trajectory generation, and validated sim-to-real transfer with collision detection for safe deployment. Extensive experiments on challenging multi-arm manipulation benchmarks demonstrate CoEnv's effectiveness in achieving high task success rates and execution efficiency, establishing a new paradigm for multi-agent embodied AI.
tldr: CoEnv is a framework for multi-agent embodied collaboration that uses a compositional environment (real+sim) to enable safe strategy exploration and reliable real-world deployment, leveraging VLM-driven planning for multi-arm manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: CoEnv是一个用于多智能体具身协作的框架，它通过组合环境（真实+仿真）支持安全策略探索和可靠的真实世界部署，利用VLM驱动的规划来解决多臂操作任务。
summary_zh: 多智能体具身系统在复杂协同操作中展现出巨大潜力，但其在空间协调、时序推理和共享工作空间感知方面仍面临严峻挑战。受人类协作中认知规划与物理执行分离的启发，我们提出组合环境概念——通过现实世界与仿真组件的协同整合，使多机器人智能体能在统一决策空间内感知意图并协同操作。基于此概念，我们开发了CoEnv框架，该框架利用仿真进行安全策略探索，同时确保在现实世界中的可靠部署。CoEnv通过三阶段运行：实现物理工作空间数字化的虚实场景重建、支持高级接口实时规划与代码化轨迹生成迭代规划的多模态大模型驱动动作合成，以及配备碰撞检测的安全部署验证式仿真迁移。在挑战性多机械臂操作基准测试中的大量实验表明，CoEnv能实现高任务成功率和执行效率，为多智能体具身人工智能建立了新范式。

title: SnapFlow: One-Step Action Generation for Flow-Matching VLAs via Progressive Self-Distillation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models based on flow matching -- such as pi0, pi0.5, and SmolVLA -- achieve state-of-the-art generalist robotic manipulation, yet their iterative denoising, typically 10 ODE steps, introduces substantial latency: on a modern GPU, denoising alone accounts for 80% of end-to-end inference time. Naively reducing the step count is unreliable, degrading success on most tasks due to the velocity field being uncalibrated for single-step jumps. We present SnapFlow, a plug-and-play self-distillation method that compresses multi-step denoising into a single forward pass (1-NFE) for flow-matching VLAs. SnapFlow mixes standard flow-matching samples with consistency samples whose targets are two-step Euler shortcut velocities computed from the model's own marginal velocity predictions, avoiding the trajectory drift caused by conditional velocities, as we analyze theoretically. A zero-initialized target-time embedding lets the network switch between local velocity estimation and global one-step generation within a single architecture. SnapFlow requires no external teacher, no architecture changes, and trains in ~12h on a single GPU. We validate on two VLA architectures spanning a 6x parameter range, with identical hyperparameters: on pi0.5 (3B) across four LIBERO suites (40 tasks, 400 episodes), SnapFlow achieves 98.75% average success -- matching the 10-step teacher at 97.75% and slightly exceeding it -- with 9.6x denoising speedup and end-to-end latency reduced from 274ms to 83ms; on SmolVLA (500M), it reduces MSE by 8.3% with 3.56x end-to-end acceleration. An action-step sweep on long-horizon tasks reveals that SnapFlow maintains its advantage across execution horizons, achieving 93% at n_act=5 where the baseline reaches only 90%. SnapFlow is orthogonal to layer-distillation and token-pruning approaches, enabling compositional speedups.
tldr: SnapFlow accelerates inference for flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models used in robotic manipulation through a plug-and-play self-distillation method that reduces denoising steps from 10 to 1, matching or exceeding teacher performance while significantly cutting latency.
tldr_zh: SnapFlow通过一种即插即用的自蒸馏方法，将用于机器人操作的流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理去噪步骤从10步减少到1步，在保持或超越教师模型性能的同时，显著降低了延迟。
summary_zh: 基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型——如pi0、pi0.5和SmolVLA——实现了顶尖的通用机器人操作性能，但其迭代去噪过程（通常需10个ODE步骤）带来了显著延迟：在现代GPU上，仅去噪环节就占端到端推理时间的80%。简单地减少步数并不可靠，由于速度场未针对单步跳跃进行校准，多数任务的成功率会下降。我们提出SnapFlow，一种即插即用的自蒸馏方法，可将流匹配VLA的多步去噪压缩为单次前向传播（1-NFE）。SnapFlow将标准流匹配样本与一致性样本混合，后者的目标是通过模型自身边缘速度预测计算的双步欧拉捷径速度，从而避免了理论分析中指出的条件速度导致的轨迹漂移。通过零初始化目标时间嵌入技术，网络可在单一架构内切换局部速度估计与全局单步生成。SnapFlow无需外部教师模型、不改变架构，且仅需单GPU训练约12小时。我们在参数范围相差6倍的两种VLA架构上使用相同超参数验证：在pi0.5（3B参数）模型上，跨越四个LIBERO测试集（40项任务，400个测试周期），SnapFlow平均成功率高达98.75%——与10步教师模型的97.75%相当并略有超越——同时实现9.6倍去噪加速，端到端延迟从274毫秒降至83毫秒；在SmolVLA（5亿参数）上，MSE降低8.3%，端到端加速3.56倍。针对长时序任务的动作步数扫描实验表明，SnapFlow在不同执行步长下均保持优势：在n_act=5时达到93%成功率，而基线模型仅90%。SnapFlow与层蒸馏及令牌剪枝方法正交，可实现复合式加速效果。

title: Delta6: A Low-Cost, 6-DOF Force-Sensing Flexible End-Effector
summary: This paper presents Delta6, a low-cost, six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) force/torque end-effector that combines antagonistic springs with magnetic encoders to deliver accurate wrench sensing while remaining as simple to assemble as flat-pack furniture. A fully 3D-printed prototype, assembled entirely from off-the-shelf parts, withstands peak forces above +/-14.4 N and torques of +/-0.33 N.m per axis; these limits can be further extended by leveraging the proposed parametric analytical model. Without calibration, Delta6 attains a 99th-percentile error of 7% full scale (FS). With lightweight sequence models, the error is reduced to 3.8% FS by the best-performing network. Benchmarks on multiple computing platforms confirm that the device's bandwidth is adjustable, enabling balanced trade-offs among update rate, accuracy, and cost, while durability, thermal drift, and zero-calibration tests confirm its robustness. With Delta6 mounted on a robot arm governed by a force-impedance controller, the system successfully performs two contact-rich tasks: buffing curved surfaces and tight assemblies. Experiments validate the design, showing that Delta6 is a robust, low-cost alternative to existing 6-DOF force sensing solutions. Open-source site: https://wings-robotics.github.io/delta6 .
tldr: Delta6 is a low-cost, 6-DOF force/torque sensing end-effector designed for robotics, demonstrated in contact-rich tasks like buffing and assembly.
tldr_zh: Delta6是一款低成本、六自由度力/扭矩传感末端执行器，专为机器人设计，在接触密集型任务（如打磨和装配）中进行了演示验证。
summary_zh: 本文介绍Delta6，一种低成本、六自由度力/扭矩末端执行器，其通过拮抗弹簧与磁性编码器的结合，实现了精确的力矩传感，同时保持了如同平板家具般简易的组装特性。该全3D打印原型完全采用市售零件组装而成，能够承受每轴±14.4N以上的峰值力与±0.33N·m的扭矩；利用本文提出的参数化解析模型，可进一步扩展这些极限值。在未经校准的情况下，Delta6实现了满量程7%的99分位误差。通过轻量级序列模型，最佳性能网络将误差降低至满量程的3.8%。在多计算平台上的基准测试证实，该设备带宽可调，能够在更新率、精度与成本之间实现平衡的权衡，而耐久性、热漂移和零位校准测试则验证了其鲁棒性。将Delta6安装于由力-阻抗控制器驱动的机械臂上，系统成功完成了两项高接触任务：曲面抛光与紧密装配。实验验证了该设计的有效性，表明Delta6是现有六维力传感方案的一种鲁棒且低成本的替代选择。开源地址：https://wings-robotics.github.io/delta6。

title: Learning-Guided Force-Feedback Model Predictive Control with Obstacle Avoidance for Robotic Deburring
summary: Model Predictive Control (MPC) is widely used for torque-controlled robots, but classical formulations often neglect real-time force feedback and struggle with contact-rich industrial tasks under collision constraints. Deburring in particular requires precise tool insertion, stable force regulation, and collision-free circular motions in challenging configurations, which exceeds the capability of standard MPC pipelines. We propose a framework that integrates force-feedback MPC with diffusion-based motion priors to address these challenges. The diffusion model serves as a memory of motion strategies, providing robust initialization and adaptation across multiple task instances, while MPC ensures safe execution with explicit force tracking, torque feasibility, and collision avoidance. We validate our approach on a torque-controlled manipulator performing industrial deburring tasks. Experiments demonstrate reliable tool insertion, accurate normal force tracking, and circular deburring motions even in hard-to-reach configurations and under obstacle constraints. To our knowledge, this is the first integration of diffusion motion priors with force-feedback MPC for collision-aware, contact-rich industrial tasks.
tldr: Proposes a diffusion model-based motion prior integrated with force-feedback Model Predictive Control for robust, collision-aware robotic deburring, validated on a torque-controlled manipulator.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于扩散模型的运动先验与力反馈模型预测控制相结合的方法，用于鲁棒且避障的机器人去毛刺任务，并在扭矩控制机械臂上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 模型预测控制（MPC）在扭矩控制机器人中应用广泛，但经典建模常忽略实时力反馈，且在碰撞约束下难以应对密集型接触的工业任务。以去毛刺为例，其要求精确的工具插入、稳定的力控制以及在复杂构型下执行无碰撞的圆周运动，这已超出标准MPC流程的能力范围。为此，本文提出一种将力反馈MPC与基于扩散模型的运动先验相结合的框架以应对上述挑战。扩散模型作为运动策略的记忆库，可为多任务场景提供稳健的初始化与自适应能力，而MPC则通过显式力跟踪、扭矩可行性与碰撞避障确保安全执行。我们在执行工业去毛刺任务的扭矩控制机械臂上验证了该方法的有效性。实验表明，即使在难以触及的构型及障碍物约束下，系统仍能实现可靠的工具插入、精确的法向力跟踪以及稳定的圆周去毛刺运动。据我们所知，这是首次将扩散运动先验与力反馈MPC相结合，用于具有碰撞感知的密集型接触工业任务。

title: You're Pushing My Buttons: Instrumented Learning of Gentle Button Presses
summary: Learning contact-rich manipulation is difficult from cameras and proprioception alone because contact events are only partially observed. We test whether training-time instrumentation, i.e., object sensorisation, can improve policy performance without creating deployment-time dependencies. Specifically, we study button pressing as a testbed and use a microphone fingertip to capture contact-relevant audio. We use an instrumented button-state signal as privileged supervision to fine-tune an audio encoder into a contact event detector. We combine the resulting representation with imitation learning using three strategies, such that the policy only uses vision and audio during inference. Button press success rates are similar across methods, but instrumentation-guided audio representations consistently reduce contact force. These results support instrumentation as a practical training-time auxiliary objective for learning contact-rich manipulation policies.
tldr: This paper explores using instrumented training with audio to improve learning for contact-rich manipulation tasks like button pressing, aiming to reduce contact force without requiring instrumentation at deployment.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了使用带音频的仪器化训练来改进接触密集型操作任务（如按钮按压）的学习，旨在减少接触力，同时避免在部署时依赖仪器。
summary_zh: 仅凭摄像头和本体感知学习接触丰富的操作是困难的，因为接触事件只能被部分观察到。我们测试了训练阶段的仪器化方法（即对象传感化）是否能在不产生部署依赖的情况下提升策略性能。具体而言，我们以按钮按压作为实验平台，利用麦克风指尖采集与接触相关的音频信号。通过将仪器化的按钮状态信号作为特权监督信息，对音频编码器进行微调，使其成为接触事件检测器。随后，我们将生成的表征与模仿学习通过三种策略相结合，确保策略在推理过程中仅依赖视觉和音频信息。各方法在按钮按压成功率上表现相近，但仪器化指导的音频表征能够持续降低接触力度。这些结果表明，仪器化作为辅助训练目标，对于学习接触丰富的操作策略具有实际应用价值。

title: Dialogue based Interactive Explanations for Safety Decisions in Human Robot Collaboration
summary: As robots increasingly operate in shared, safety critical environments, acting safely is no longer sufficient robots must also make their safety decisions intelligible to human collaborators. In human robot collaboration (HRC), behaviours such as stopping or switching modes are often triggered by internal safety constraints that remain opaque to nearby workers. We present a dialogue based framework for interactive explanation of safety decisions in HRC. The approach tightly couples explanation with constraint based safety evaluation, grounding dialogue in the same state and constraint representations that govern behaviour selection. Explanations are derived directly from the recorded decision trace, enabling users to pose causal ("Why?"), contrastive ("Why not?"), and counterfactual ("What if?") queries about safety interventions. Counterfactual reasoning is evaluated in a bounded manner under fixed, certified safety parameters, ensuring that interactive exploration does not relax operational guarantees. We instantiate the framework in a construction robotics scenario and provide a structured operational trace illustrating how constraint aware dialogue clarifies safety interventions and supports coordinated task recovery. By treating explanation as an operational interface to safety control, this work advances a design perspective for interactive, safety aware autonomy in HRC.
tldr: The paper proposes a dialogue-based framework for explaining safety decisions in human-robot collaboration, enabling users to query 'why', 'why not', and 'what if' about robot actions using the same constraint representations that govern behavior.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于对话的框架，用于解释人机协作中的安全决策，使用户能够基于控制行为选择的相同约束表示，对机器人动作进行'为什么'、'为什么不'和'如果...会怎样'的查询。
summary_zh: 随着机器人在共享的安全关键环境中日益普及，仅确保其行为安全已不再足够——机器人还必须能让人类协作伙伴理解其安全决策。在人类-机器人协作（HRC）场景中，诸如停止或模式切换等行为往往由内部安全约束触发，而周边工作人员对此往往无法知晓。本文提出一种基于对话的框架，用于HRC中安全决策的交互式解释。该方法将解释与基于约束的安全评估紧密结合，使对话立足于与行为选择相同的状态和约束表征基础之上。解释直接来源于记录的决策轨迹，用户可借此提出关于安全干预措施的因果性（“为何如此？”）、对比性（“为何不如此？”）及反事实（“如果…会怎样？”）的查询。反事实推理在固定且经过认证的安全参数范围内进行有界评估，确保交互式探索不会削弱运行保障。我们在建筑机器人场景中实现了该框架，并通过结构化运行轨迹展示约束感知对话如何阐明安全干预措施并支持协同任务恢复。通过将解释视为安全控制的可操作接口，本研究为推动HRC中交互式、安全感知自主系统的设计提供了新的视角。

title: Precise Aggressive Aerial Maneuvers with Sensorimotor Policies
summary: Precise aggressive maneuvers with lightweight onboard sensors remains a key bottleneck in fully exploiting the maneuverability of drones. Such maneuvers are critical for expanding the systems' accessible area by navigating through narrow openings in the environment. Among the most relevant problems, a representative one is aggressive traversal through narrow gaps with quadrotors under SE(3) constraints, which require the quadrotors to leverage a momentary tilted attitude and the asymmetry of the airframe to navigate through gaps. In this paper, we achieve such maneuvers by developing sensorimotor policies directly mapping onboard vision and proprioception into low-level control commands. The policies are trained using reinforcement learning (RL) with end-to-end policy distillation in simulation. We mitigate the fundamental hardness of model-free RL's exploration on the restricted solution space with an initialization strategy leveraging trajectories generated by a model-based planner. Careful sim-to-real design allows the policy to control a quadrotor through narrow gaps with low clearances and high repeatability. For instance, the proposed method enables a quadrotor to navigate a rectangular gap at a 5 cm clearance, tilted at up to 90-degree orientation, without knowledge of the gap's position or orientation. Without training on dynamic gaps, the policy can reactively servo the quadrotor to traverse through a moving gap. The proposed method is also validated by training and deploying policies on challenging tracks of narrow gaps placed closely. The flexibility of the policy learning method is demonstrated by developing policies for geometrically diverse gaps, without relying on manually defined traversal poses and visual features.
tldr: This paper presents a method for achieving aggressive drone maneuvers through narrow gaps using RL-trained sensorimotor policies that map onboard vision and proprioception to control commands, with careful sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过使用强化学习训练的传感器运动策略，将机载视觉和本体感觉映射到控制指令，从而实现无人机穿越狭窄间隙的激进机动，并注重仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 轻量机载传感器下的精确激进行动仍然是充分发挥无人机机动性的关键瓶颈。此类机动对于通过环境中的狭窄开口导航以扩大系统可访问区域至关重要。在最具代表性的问题中，通过四旋翼在SE(3)约束下实现穿越狭窄缝隙的激进行动尤为典型，这要求四旋翼利用瞬时倾斜姿态及机身不对称性通过缝隙。本文通过开发感知运动策略，将机载视觉与本体感觉直接映射至底层控制命令，实现了此类机动。策略采用强化学习在仿真环境中通过端到端策略蒸馏进行训练。我们通过基于模型规划器生成的轨迹初始化策略，缓解了无模型强化学习在受限解空间探索的根本性困难。精心的仿真到现实设计使策略能够以低裕度和高重复性控制四旋翼穿越狭窄缝隙。例如，所提方法使四旋翼能在未知缝隙位置与方向的情况下，以5厘米裕度穿越倾斜角度达90度的矩形缝隙。未经动态缝隙训练的策略仍能通过反应式伺服控制穿越移动缝隙。通过在密集排列的狭窄缝隙挑战性轨道上进行策略训练与部署，进一步验证了所提方法。策略学习方法通过针对几何形态多样缝隙开发策略，展现了不依赖人工定义穿越姿态与视觉特征的灵活性。

title: GraspSense: Physically Grounded Grasp and Grip Planning for a Dexterous Robotic Hand via Language-Guided Perception and Force Maps
summary: Dexterous robotic manipulation requires more than geometrically valid grasps: it demands physically grounded contact strategies that account for the spatially non-uniform mechanical properties of the object. However, existing grasp planners typically treat the surface as structurally homogeneous, even though contact in a weak region can damage the object despite a geometrically perfect grasp. We present a pipeline for grasp selection and force regulation in a five-fingered robotic hand, based on a map of locally admissible contact loads. From an operator command, the system identifies the target object, reconstructs its 3D geometry using SAM3D, and imports the model into Isaac Sim. A physics-informed geometric analysis then computes a force map that encodes the maximum lateral contact force admissible at each surface location without deformation. Grasp candidates are filtered by geometric validity and task-goal consistency. When multiple candidates are comparable under classical metrics, they are re-ranked using a force-map-aware criterion that favors grasps with contacts in mechanically admissible regions. An impedance controller scales the stiffness of each finger according to the locally admissible force at the contact point, enabling safe and reliable grasp execution. Validation on paper, plastic, and glass cups shows that the proposed approach consistently selects structurally stronger contact regions and keeps grip forces within safe bounds. In this way, the work reframes dexterous manipulation from a purely geometric problem into a physically grounded joint planning problem of grasp selection and grip execution for future humanoid systems.
tldr: The paper presents a robotic grasp planning pipeline for a dexterous hand that uses language-guided perception and a physics-based force map to select structurally robust contact points and regulate grip forces, moving beyond purely geometric planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于灵巧手的机器人抓取规划流程，该流程利用语言引导的感知和基于物理的力映射来选择结构上更稳健的接触点并调节抓握力，超越了纯几何规划。
summary_zh: 灵巧的机器人操作不仅需要几何上有效的抓取，更要求基于物理现实的接触策略，以考虑物体在空间中非均匀分布的机械特性。然而，现有的抓取规划器通常将物体表面视为结构均匀的整体，而实际上，即使在几何上完美的抓取点，接触薄弱区域也可能导致物体受损。本文提出了一套用于五指灵巧手的抓取选择与力调节系统流程，其核心基于局部允许接触载荷分布图。系统首先根据操作者指令识别目标物体，利用SAM3D重建其三维几何模型，并将模型导入Isaac Sim中。随后，通过物理信息驱动的几何分析，计算出力分布图，该图编码了物体表面各位置在不变形前提下可承受的最大横向接触力。抓取候选方案首先通过几何有效性和任务目标一致性进行筛选。当多个候选方案在传统指标下表现相近时，则采用力分布图感知准则进行重新排序，优先选择接触点位于机械允许区域的抓取方式。阻抗控制器根据各接触点的局部允许力调整对应手指的刚度，从而实现安全可靠的抓取执行。在纸杯、塑料杯和玻璃杯上的实验验证表明，该方法能稳定选择结构强度更高的接触区域，并将抓握力控制在安全范围内。这项工作将灵巧操作从纯几何问题重新定义为基于物理现实的抓取选择与执行联合规划问题，为未来类人机器人系统提供了新思路。

title: Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Few-Step Visual Navigation
summary: Visual navigation is a core challenge in Embodied AI, requiring autonomous agents to translate high-dimensional sensory observations into continuous, long-horizon action trajectories. While generative policies based on diffusion models and Schrödinger Bridges (SB) effectively capture multimodal action distributions, they require dozens of integration steps due to high-variance stochastic transport, posing a critical barrier for real-time robotic control. We propose Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching (RSBM), a framework that exploits a shared velocity-field structure between standard Schrödinger Bridges ($\varepsilon=1$, maximum-entropy transport) and deterministic Optimal Transport ($\varepsilon\to 0$, as in Conditional Flow Matching), controlled by a single entropic regularization parameter $\varepsilon$. We prove two key results: (1) the conditional velocity field's functional form is invariant across the entire $\varepsilon$-spectrum (Velocity Structure Invariance), enabling a single network to serve all regularization strengths; and (2) reducing $\varepsilon$ linearly decreases the conditional velocity variance, enabling more stable coarse-step ODE integration. Anchored to a learned conditional prior that shortens transport distance, RSBM operates at an intermediate $\varepsilon$ that balances multimodal coverage and path straightness. Empirically, while standard bridges require $\geq 10$ steps to converge, RSBM achieves over 94% cosine similarity and 92% success rate in merely 3 integration steps -- without distillation or multi-stage training -- substantially narrowing the gap between high-fidelity generative policies and the low-latency demands of Embodied AI.
tldr: The paper introduces RSBM, a method for reducing the number of integration steps needed for visual navigation policies based on Schrödinger Bridges, enabling real-time control for embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了RSBM方法，用于减少基于薛定谔桥的视觉导航策略所需的积分步数，从而实现实体智能体的实时控制。
summary_zh: 视觉导航是具身人工智能的一个核心挑战，它要求自主智能体将高维感知观测转换为连续、长视野的动作轨迹。尽管基于扩散模型和薛定谔桥的生成策略能有效捕捉多模态动作分布，但由于高方差的随机传输特性，它们需要数十个积分步骤才能完成，这为实时机器人控制带来了关键障碍。我们提出了修正薛定谔桥匹配（RSBM）框架，该框架利用标准薛定谔桥（$\varepsilon=1$，代表最大熵传输）与确定性最优传输（$\varepsilon\to 0$，如条件流匹配所采用）之间共享的速率场结构，通过一个单一的熵正则化参数 $\varepsilon$ 进行调控。我们证明了两个关键结果：（1）条件速率场的函数形式在整个 $\varepsilon$ 谱系中保持不变（速率场结构不变性），使得单一网络可服务于所有正则化强度；（2）降低 $\varepsilon$ 会线性减少条件速率场方差，从而支持更稳定的粗步长常微分方程积分。通过学习一个缩短传输距离的条件先验作为锚点，RSBM 在中等 $\varepsilon$ 值下运行，平衡了多模态覆盖与路径平直度。实验表明，标准桥方法需要至少 10 步积分才能收敛，而 RSBM 仅需 3 步积分即可实现超过 94% 的余弦相似度和 92% 的成功率——无需蒸馏或多阶段训练——从而显著缩小了高保真生成策略与具身人工智能低延迟需求之间的差距。

title: Referring-Aware Visuomotor Policy Learning for Closed-Loop Manipulation
summary: This paper addresses a fundamental problem of visuomotor policy learning for robotic manipulation: how to enhance robustness in out-of-distribution execution errors or dynamically re-routing trajectories, where the model relies solely on the original expert demonstrations for training. We introduce the Referring-Aware Visuomotor Policy (ReV), a closed-loop framework that can adapt to unforeseen circumstances by instantly incorporating sparse referring points provided by a human or a high-level reasoning planner. Specifically, ReV leverages the coupled diffusion heads to preserve standard task execution patterns while seamlessly integrating sparse referring via a trajectory-steering strategy. Upon receiving a specific referring point, the global diffusion head firstly generates a sequence of globally consistent yet temporally sparse action anchors, while identifies the precise temporal position for the referring point within this sequence. Subsequently, the local diffusion head adaptively interpolates adjacent anchors based on the current temporal position for specific tasks. This closed-loop process repeats at every execution step, enabling real-time trajectory replanning in response to dynamic changes in the scene. In practice, rather than relying on elaborate annotations, ReV is trained only by applying targeted perturbations to expert demonstrations. Without any additional data or fine-tuning scheme, ReV achieve higher success rates across challenging simulated and real-world tasks.
tldr: The paper introduces ReV, a closed-loop visuomotor policy for robotic manipulation that uses coupled diffusion heads to adapt trajectories in real-time by integrating sparse human or planner-provided referring points, trained solely with perturbed expert demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ReV，一种用于机器人操作的闭环视觉运动策略，通过耦合的扩散头，整合稀疏的人或高层规划器提供的参考点，实时适应轨迹变化，仅使用扰动后的专家演示数据进行训练。
summary_zh: 本文探讨了机器人操作中视觉运动策略学习的一个基本问题：如何在仅依靠原始专家演示进行训练的情况下，增强模型在分布外执行误差或动态重规划轨迹中的鲁棒性。我们提出了参照感知视觉运动策略（ReV），这是一个闭环框架，能够通过即时整合由人类或高层推理规划器提供的稀疏参照点，从而适应未预见的场景变化。具体而言，ReV利用耦合扩散头来维持标准的任务执行模式，同时通过轨迹引导策略无缝融合稀疏参照点。在接收到特定参照点后，全局扩散头首先生成一系列全局一致且时间稀疏的动作锚点，并确定该参照点在此序列中的精确时间位置。随后，局部扩散头基于当前时间位置自适应地对相邻锚点进行插值，以完成特定任务。这一闭环过程在每一步执行中重复进行，实现了对场景动态变化的实时轨迹重规划。在实际应用中，ReV无需依赖精细的标注，仅通过对专家演示施加有针对性的扰动进行训练。在不使用任何额外数据或微调方案的情况下，ReV在具有挑战性的仿真和真实世界任务中均取得了更高的成功率。

title: MARS-Dragonfly: Agile and Robust Flight Control of Modular Aerial Robot Systems
summary: Modular Aerial Robot Systems (MARS) comprise multiple drone units with reconfigurable connected formations, providing high adaptability to diverse mission scenarios, fault conditions, and payload capacities. However, existing control algorithms for MARS rely on simplified quasi-static models and rule-based allocation, which generate discontinuous and unbounded motor commands. This leads to attitude error accumulation as the number of drone units scales, ultimately causing severe oscillations during docking, separation, and waypoint tracking. To address these limitations, we first design a compact mechanical system that enables passive docking, detection-free passive locking, and magnetic-assisted separation using a single micro servo. Second, we introduce a force-torque-equivalent and polytope-constraint virtual quadrotor that explicitly models feasible wrench sets. Together, these abstractions capture the full MARS dynamics and enable existing quadrotor controllers to be applied across different configurations. We further optimize the yaw angle that maximizes control authority to enhance agility. Third, building on this abstraction, we design a two-stage predictive-allocation pipeline: a constrained predictive tracker computes virtual inputs while respecting force/torque bounds, and a dynamic allocator maps these inputs to individual modules with balanced objectives to produce smooth, trackable motor commands. Simulations across over 10 configurations and real-world experiments demonstrate stable docking, locking, and separation, as well as effective control performance. To our knowledge, this is the first real-world demonstration of MARS achieving agile flight and transport with 40 deg peak pitch while maintaining an average position error of 0.0896 m. The video is available at: https://youtu.be/yqjccrIpz5o
tldr: This paper introduces a novel control framework for modular aerial robot systems, enabling stable and agile flight for reconfigurable multi-drone formations through a two-stage predictive control pipeline and optimized mechanical design.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模块化空中机器人系统的新型控制框架，通过两阶段预测控制管道和优化的机械设计，实现了可重构多无人机编队的稳定和敏捷飞行。
summary_zh: 模块化空中机器人系统（MARS）由多个可重构连接编队的无人机单元组成，能够高度适应不同任务场景、故障条件和载荷能力。然而，现有的MARS控制算法依赖于简化的准静态模型和基于规则的分配策略，这会产生不连续且无界的电机指令。随着无人机单元数量的增加，将导致姿态误差累积，最终在对接、分离和航点跟踪过程中引发严重振荡。为解决这些局限，我们首先设计了一种紧凑型机械系统，仅使用单个微型舵机即可实现被动对接、无感测被动锁定和磁辅助分离。其次，我们引入了一种力-扭矩等效且满足多面体约束的虚拟四旋翼模型，该模型显式地描述了可行的力/力矩集合。这些抽象模型共同完整刻画了MARS的动态特性，使得现有四旋翼控制器能够适用于不同构型。我们还进一步优化了偏航角以最大化控制效能，从而提升系统敏捷性。第三，基于此抽象模型，我们设计了一个两阶段预测分配管道：约束预测跟踪器在满足力/力矩边界的前提下计算虚拟输入，动态分配器则以平衡目标将这些输入映射到独立模块，生成平滑可跟踪的电机指令。通过超过10种构型的仿真和真实环境实验，系统展示了稳定的对接、锁定与分离功能，以及高效的控制性能。据我们所知，这是首次在真实场景中实现MARS的敏捷飞行与运输，系统在保持平均位置误差0.0896米的同时达到40度峰值俯仰角。演示视频见：https://youtu.be/yqjccrIpz5o

title: Synergizing Efficiency and Reliability for Continuous Mobile Manipulation
summary: Humans seamlessly fuse anticipatory planning with immediate feedback to perform successive mobile manipulation tasks without stopping, achieving both high efficiency and reliability. Replicating this fluid and reliable behavior in robots remains fundamentally challenging, not only due to conflicts between long-horizon planning and real-time reactivity, but also because excessively pursuing efficiency undermines reliability in uncertain environments: it impairs stable perception and the potential for compensation, while also increasing the risk of unintended contact. In this work, we present a unified framework that synergizes efficiency and reliability for continuous mobile manipulation. It features a reliability-aware trajectory planner that embeds essential elements for reliable execution into spatiotemporal optimization, generating efficient and reliability-promising global trajectories. It is coupled with a phase-dependent switching controller that seamlessly transitions between global trajectory tracking for efficiency and task-error compensation for reliability. We also investigate a hierarchical initialization that facilitates online replanning despite the complexity of long-horizon planning problems. Real-world evaluations demonstrate that our approach enables efficient and reliable completion of successive tasks under uncertainty (e.g., dynamic disturbances, perception and control errors). Moreover, the framework generalizes to tasks with diverse end-effector constraints. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our method consistently achieves the highest efficiency while improving the task success rate by 26.67\%--81.67\%. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the contribution of each component. The source code will be released.
tldr: This paper presents a unified framework for continuous mobile manipulation that combines reliability-aware trajectory planning with a phase-dependent switching controller to balance efficiency and real-time reliability in uncertain environments, demonstrated with real-world robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于连续移动操作的统一框架，它结合了可靠性感知的轨迹规划和阶段相关的切换控制器，在不确定环境中平衡效率与实时可靠性，并通过真实机器人实验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 人类在执行连续移动操作任务时，能够无缝融合前瞻性规划与即时反馈，实现高效性与可靠性的统一。在机器人中复现这种流畅可靠的行为仍面临根本性挑战，这不仅源于长时程规划与实时响应之间的冲突，更因为过度追求效率会损害不确定环境下的可靠性：它既影响感知稳定性与补偿能力，又增加非预期接触的风险。本研究提出一种融合效率与可靠性的统一框架，用于连续移动操作。该框架的核心是可靠性感知轨迹规划器，将可靠执行的关键要素嵌入时空优化，生成高效且具备可靠性潜力的全局轨迹；结合相依赖切换控制器，在追求效率的全局轨迹跟踪与保障可靠性的任务误差补偿间无缝切换。我们还提出一种分层初始化策略，以应对长时程规划问题的复杂性，实现在线重规划。真实场景实验表明，本方法能在动态扰动、感知与控制误差等不确定条件下，高效可靠地完成连续任务。该框架可泛化至具有不同末端执行器约束的任务场景。相比现有先进基线方法，本方法在持续保持最高效率的同时，将任务成功率提升26.67\%--81.67\%。系统性消融实验进一步验证了各模块的贡献。源代码将予以公开。

title: Pre-Execution Safety Gate & Task Safety Contracts for LLM-Controlled Robot Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to convert task commands into robot-executable code, however this pipeline lacks validation gates to detect unsafe and defective commands before they are translated into robot code. Furthermore, even commands that appear safe at the outset can produce unsafe state transitions during execution in the absence of continuous constraint monitoring. In this research, we introduce SafeGate, a neurosymbolic safety architecture that prevents unsafe natural language task commands from reaching robot execution. Drawing from ISO 13482 safety standard, SafeGate extracts structured safety-relevant properties from natural language commands and applies a deterministic decision gate to authorize or reject execution. In addition, we introduce Task Safety Contracts, which decomposes commands that pass through the gate into invariants, guards, and abort conditions to prevent unsafe state transitions during execution. We further incorporate Z3 SMT solving to enforce constraint checking derived from the Task Safety Contracts. We evaluate SafeGate against existing LLM-based robot safety frameworks and baseline LLMs across 230 benchmark tasks, 30 AI2-THOR simulation scenarios, and real-world robot experiments. Results show that SafeGate significantly reduces the acceptance of defective commands while maintaining a high acceptance of benign tasks, demonstrating the importance of pre-execution safety gates for LLM-controlled robot systems
tldr: Introduces SafeGate, a neurosymbolic safety architecture with a pre-execution gate and task safety contracts, to prevent unsafe commands from being executed on LLM-controlled robot systems.
tldr_zh: 提出了SafeGate，一种神经符号安全架构，包含预执行门和安全任务契约，用于防止LLM控制的机器人系统执行不安全指令。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于将任务指令转化为机器人可执行的代码，然而这一流程缺乏验证环节，无法在将指令转化为机器人代码之前检测出存在安全隐患或存在缺陷的命令。此外，即使初始看起来安全的指令，在执行过程中若缺少持续的状态约束监控，也可能导致不安全的状态转换。本研究提出了一种名为 SafeGate 的神经符号安全架构，旨在防止不安全的自然语言任务指令到达机器人执行阶段。借鉴 ISO 13482 安全标准，SafeGate 从自然语言指令中提取结构化的安全相关属性，并应用确定性决策门来授权或拒绝执行。此外，我们引入了任务安全契约机制，将经过决策门的指令分解为不变条件、触发条件和中止条件，以避免执行过程中发生不安全的状态转换。我们进一步整合了 Z3 可满足性模理论求解器，以强制执行来自任务安全契约的约束检查。我们在 230 项基准任务、30 个 AI2-THOR 模拟场景以及真实机器人实验中，将 SafeGate 与现有的基于 LLM 的机器人安全框架及基线 LLM 进行了对比评估。结果表明，SafeGate 在保持对良性任务的高接受率的同时，显著降低了对缺陷指令的接受度，证明了预执行安全门机制对于 LLM 控制的机器人系统具有重要作用。

title: AnyImageNav: Any-View Geometry for Precise Last-Meter Image-Goal Navigation
summary: Image Goal Navigation (ImageNav) is evaluated by a coarse success criterion, the agent must stop within 1m of the target, which is sufficient for finding objects but falls short for downstream tasks such as grasping that require precise positioning. We introduce AnyImageNav, a training-free system that pushes ImageNav toward this more demanding setting. Our key insight is that the goal image can be treated as a geometric query: any photo of an object, a hallway, or a room corner can be registered to the agent's observations via dense pixel-level correspondences, enabling recovery of the exact 6-DoF camera pose. Our method realizes this through a semantic-to-geometric cascade: a semantic relevance signal guides exploration and acts as a proximity gate, invoking a 3D multi-view foundation model only when the current view is highly relevant to the goal image; the model then self-certifies its registration in a loop for an accurate recovered pose. Our method sets state-of-the-art navigation success rates on Gibson (93.1%) and HM3D (82.6%), and achieves pose recovery that prior methods do not provide: a position error of 0.27m and heading error of 3.41 degrees on Gibson, and 0.21m / 1.23 degrees on HM3D, a 5-10x improvement over adapted baselines.Our project page: https://yijie21.github.io/ain/
tldr: This paper introduces AnyImageNav, a training-free system for precise last-meter Image-Goal Navigation, using a semantic-to-geometric cascade to recover 6-DoF camera pose for improved positioning beyond traditional success criteria.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的系统AnyImageNav，用于实现精确的最后一米图像目标导航，通过语义-几何级联方法恢复6-DoF相机位姿，显著提升了导航的定位精度。
summary_zh: 图像目标导航任务的评估通常采用粗粒度成功标准：智能体需在距目标1米范围内停止。该标准对物体搜寻任务已足够，但无法满足抓取等需要精确定位的下游任务需求。本文提出一种免训练的AnyImageNav系统，将图像导航推向更高要求的应用场景。我们的核心观点是将目标图像视作几何查询：通过密集像素级对应关系，任何物体、走廊或房间角落的照片都可与智能体观测数据配准，从而恢复精确的六自由度相机位姿。该方法通过语义到几何的级联流程实现：语义相关性信号引导探索并作为邻近度闸门，仅当当前视角与目标图像高度相关时，才调用三维多视图基础模型；该模型随后通过循环自验证实现配准，获得精确的位姿恢复结果。本方法在Gibson数据集（93.1%）和HM3D数据集（82.6%）上刷新了导航成功率记录，并实现了现有方法无法达到的位姿恢复精度：在Gibson数据集上位置误差0.27米、航向角误差3.41度，在HM3D数据集上位置误差0.21米、航向角误差1.23度，较改进基线方法提升5-10倍。项目页面：https://yijie21.github.io/ain/

title: ExpressMM: Expressive Mobile Manipulation Behaviors in Human-Robot Interactions
summary: Mobile manipulators are increasingly deployed in human-centered environments to perform tasks. While completing such tasks, they should also be able to communicate their intent to the people around them using expressive robot behaviors. Prior work on expressive robot behaviors has used preprogrammed or learning-from-demonstration- based expressive motions and large language model generated high-level interactions. The majority of these existing approaches have not considered human-robot interactions (HRI) where users may interrupt, modify, or redirect a robot's actions during task execution. In this paper, we develop the novel ExpressMM framework that integrates a high-level language-guided planner based on a vision-language model for perception and conversational reasoning with a low-level vision-language-action policy to generate expressive robot behaviors during collaborative HRI tasks. Furthermore, ExpressMM supports interruptible interactions to accommodate updated or redirecting instructions by users. We demonstrate ExpressMM on a mobile manipulator assisting a human in a collaborative assembly scenario and conduct audience-based evaluation of live HRI demonstrations. Questionnaire results show that the ExpressMM-enabled expressive behaviors helped observers clearly interpret the robot's actions and intentions while supporting socially appropriate and understandable interactions. Participants also reported that the robot was useful for collaborative tasks and behaved in a predictable and safe manner during the demonstrations, fostering positive perceptions of the robot's usefulness, safety, and predictability during the collaborative tasks.
tldr: Proposes ExpressMM, a framework integrating high-level language-guided planning and low-level vision-language-action policy for generating expressive behaviors in mobile manipulators during collaborative human-robot interactions.
tldr_zh: 提出ExpressMM框架，集成高层语言引导规划和低层视觉-语言-动作策略，为移动操作机器人在协作人机交互中生成表达性行为，支持可中断交互。
summary_zh: 移动操作机器人在以人为中心的环境中正被越来越多地部署以执行任务。在完成这些任务的同时，它们还应能够通过富有表现力的机器人行为向周围人员传达其意图。此前关于机器人表现行为的研究已采用预编程或基于示教学习的表现性动作，以及由大型语言模型生成的高层交互方式。然而，这些现有方法大多未考虑在任务执行过程中用户可能中断、修改或重定向机器人动作的人机交互场景。本文提出了一种新颖的ExpressMM框架，该框架将基于视觉语言模型的高层语言引导规划器（用于感知与对话推理）与低层视觉-语言-动作策略相结合，以在协作式人机交互任务中生成富有表现力的机器人行为。此外，ExpressMM支持可中断的交互，以适应用户更新的或重定向的指令。我们在移动操作机器人辅助人类完成协作装配任务的场景中验证了ExpressMM，并基于现场人机交互演示开展了观众评估。问卷结果表明，ExpressMM驱动的表现行为有助于观察者清晰理解机器人的动作与意图，同时支持社交上恰当且易于理解的交互。参与者还反馈，机器人在演示过程中对协作任务具有实用性，且行为方式可预测且安全，从而提升了人们对机器人在协作任务中的实用性、安全性与可预测性的积极认知。

title: ZipFold: Modular Actuators for Scaleable Adaptive Robots
summary: There is a growing need for robots that can change their shape, size and mechanical properties to adapt to evolving tasks and environments. However, current shape-changing systems generally utilize bespoke, system-specific mechanisms that can be difficult to scale, reconfigure or translate from one application to another. This paper introduces a compact, easy-to-fabricate deployable actuator that achieves reversible scale and stiffness transformations through compound folding and zipping of flexible 3D-printed plastic strips into square-section deployable beams. The simple actuation method allows for smooth, continuous transitions between compact (flexible) and expanded (quasi-rigid) states, facilitating diverse shape and stiffness transformations when modules are combined into larger assemblies. The actuator's mechanical performance is characterized and an integrated system involving a four-module adaptive walking robot is demonstrated.
tldr: The paper introduces a compact, deployable actuator using 3D-printed plastic strips that can reversibly change scale and stiffness, enabling adaptive shape-changing robots, as demonstrated with a walking robot.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种紧凑的、可展开的致动器，使用3D打印塑料条带，可逆地改变尺度和刚度，实现自适应形态变化机器人，并通过一个行走机器人进行了演示。
summary_zh: 随着任务与环境不断变化，对能够改变形状、尺寸及机械性能的机器人需求日益增长。然而，现有的形态可变系统通常采用定制化、系统专属的机制，难以在不同应用间实现扩展、重构或迁移。本文介绍了一种紧凑、易于制造的展开式执行器，其通过将柔性3D打印塑料条带复合折叠并锁定为方形截面可展开梁，实现了可逆的尺度与刚度转换。这种简单的驱动方式使执行器能在紧凑（柔性）状态与展开（准刚性）状态之间平滑连续地过渡，当多个模块组合成更大结构时，能够实现多样的形态与刚度变换。研究对执行器的机械性能进行了表征，并展示了包含四模块自适应行走机器人的集成系统。

title: RoboPlayground: Democratizing Robotic Evaluation through Structured Physical Domains
summary: Evaluation of robotic manipulation systems has largely relied on fixed benchmarks authored by a small number of experts, where task instances, constraints, and success criteria are predefined and difficult to extend. This paradigm limits who can shape evaluation and obscures how policies respond to user-authored variations in task intent, constraints, and notions of success. We argue that evaluating modern manipulation policies requires reframing evaluation as a language-driven process over structured physical domains. We present RoboPlayground, a framework that enables users to author executable manipulation tasks using natural language within a structured physical domain. Natural language instructions are compiled into reproducible task specifications with explicit asset definitions, initialization distributions, and success predicates. Each instruction defines a structured family of related tasks, enabling controlled semantic and behavioral variation while preserving executability and comparability. We instantiate RoboPlayground in a structured block manipulation domain and evaluate it along three axes. A user study shows that the language-driven interface is easier to use and imposes lower cognitive workload than programming-based and code-assist baselines. Evaluating learned policies on language-defined task families reveals generalization failures that are not apparent under fixed benchmark evaluations. Finally, we show that task diversity scales with contributor diversity rather than task count alone, enabling evaluation spaces to grow continuously through crowd-authored contributions. Project Page: https://roboplayground.github.io
tldr: The paper introduces RoboPlayground, a framework for authoring and evaluating robotic manipulation tasks using natural language, enabling user-defined variations and more comprehensive policy testing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoboPlayground，一个通过自然语言编写和评估机器人操作任务的框架，支持用户定义的任务变化和更全面的策略测试。
summary_zh: 机器人操作系统的评估主要依赖于少数专家制定的固定基准，其中任务实例、约束条件和成功标准均为预定义且难以扩展。这种范式限制了参与评估设计的人员范围，并掩盖了策略如何响应用户在任务意图、约束条件和成功标准方面提出的变化。我们认为，评估现代操作策略需要将评估重新定义为基于结构化物理域的语言驱动过程。为此，我们提出RoboPlayground框架，使用户能够通过自然语言在结构化物理域中创建可执行的操作任务。自然语言指令被编译为可复现的任务规范，包含明确的资产定义、初始化分布和成功判定条件。每条指令都定义了一个结构化的相关任务族，在保持可执行性和可比性的同时，实现了受控的语义与行为变化。我们在结构化积木操作域中实现了RoboPlayground，并从三个维度对其进行评估。用户研究表明，与基于编程和代码辅助的基线方法相比，语言驱动界面更易于使用且认知负荷更低。通过在语言定义的任务族上评估学习策略，我们发现了在固定基准评估中无法显现的泛化失效问题。最后，我们证明任务多样性随贡献者多样性（而非仅任务数量）而扩展，使得评估空间能够通过众包贡献持续增长。项目页面：https://roboplayground.github.io

title: GaussFly: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning for Visuomotor Policies in 3D Gaussian Fields
summary: Learning visuomotor policies for Autonomous Aerial Vehicles (AAVs) relying solely on monocular vision is an attractive yet highly challenging paradigm. Existing end-to-end learning approaches directly map high-dimensional RGB observations to action commands, which frequently suffer from low sample efficiency and severe sim-to-real gaps due to the visual discrepancy between simulation and physical domains. To address these long-standing challenges, we propose GaussFly, a novel framework that explicitly decouples representation learning from policy optimization through a cohesive real-to-sim-to-real paradigm. First, to achieve a high-fidelity real-to-sim transition, we reconstruct training scenes using 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) augmented with explicit geometric constraints. Second, to ensure robust sim-to-real transfer, we leverage these photorealistic simulated environments and employ contrastive representation learning to extract compact, noise-resilient latent features from the rendered RGB images. By utilizing this pre-trained encoder to provide low-dimensional feature inputs, the computational burden on the visuomotor policy is significantly reduced while its resistance against visual noise is inherently enhanced. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that GaussFly achieves superior sample efficiency and asymptotic performance compared to baselines. Crucially, it enables robust and zero-shot policy transfer to unseen real-world environments with complex textures, effectively bridging the sim-to-real gap.
tldr: The paper introduces GaussFly, a framework for learning visuomotor policies for Autonomous Aerial Vehicles (AAVs) that uses 3D Gaussian Splatting and contrastive representation learning to improve sample efficiency and enable zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GaussFly框架，用于学习自主飞行器的视觉运动策略，该框架利用3D高斯泼溅和对比表征学习来提高样本效率，并实现零样本模拟到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 仅依赖单目视觉为自主飞行器学习视觉运动策略是一种极具吸引力却极具挑战性的研究范式。现有端到端学习方法直接将高维RGB观测映射为动作指令，常因仿真与物理域间的视觉差异而面临样本效率低下和严重的仿真到真实迁移差距。针对这些长期存在的挑战，我们提出了GaussFly——一种通过连贯的"真实-仿真-真实"范式，将表征学习与策略优化显式解耦的新型框架。首先，为实现高保真的真实到仿真过渡，我们采用增强显式几何约束的3D高斯溅射技术重构训练场景。其次，为确保稳健的仿真到真实迁移，我们利用这些照片级真实的仿真环境，通过对比表征学习从渲染的RGB图像中提取紧凑且抗噪的潜在特征。通过使用预训练编码器提供低维特征输入，视觉运动策略的计算负担显著降低，同时其对抗视觉噪声的能力得到本质提升。在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验表明，GaussFly相比基线方法实现了更优的样本效率与渐进性能。关键的是，该框架能够实现零样本策略迁移至具有复杂纹理的未知真实环境，有效弥合了仿真与真实之间的鸿沟。

title: FunRec: Reconstructing Functional 3D Scenes from Egocentric Interaction Videos
summary: We present FunRec, a method for reconstructing functional 3D digital twins of indoor scenes directly from egocentric RGB-D interaction videos. Unlike existing methods on articulated reconstruction, which rely on controlled setups, multi-state captures, or CAD priors, FunRec operates directly on in-the-wild human interaction sequences to recover interactable 3D scenes. It automatically discovers articulated parts, estimates their kinematic parameters, tracks their 3D motion, and reconstructs static and moving geometry in canonical space, yielding simulation-compatible meshes. Across new real and simulated benchmarks, FunRec surpasses prior work by a large margin, achieving up to +50 mIoU improvement in part segmentation, 5-10 times lower articulation and pose errors, and significantly higher reconstruction accuracy. We further demonstrate applications on URDF/USD export for simulation, hand-guided affordance mapping and robot-scene interaction.
tldr: FunRec reconstructs functional 3D scenes from egocentric interaction videos, automatically discovering articulated parts and kinematics to produce simulation-compatible meshes, and is demonstrated for robot-scene interaction.
tldr_zh: FunRec 从第一人称交互视频中重建功能性的3D场景，自动发现可动部件和运动学参数以生成仿真兼容的网格，并展示了其在机器人-场景交互中的应用。
summary_zh: 本文提出FunRec方法，该方法可直接从第一人称视角的RGB-D交互视频中重建室内场景的功能性3D数字孪生体。与依赖受控设置、多状态采集或CAD先验的现有铰接式重建方法不同，FunRec直接基于真实场景中的人机交互序列来恢复可交互的3D场景。它能自动识别铰接部件、估算运动学参数、跟踪三维运动轨迹，并在规范空间中重建静态与动态几何结构，最终生成兼容仿真的网格模型。在真实与模拟场景的新基准测试中，FunRec以显著优势超越现有方法：部件分割指标提升高达50 mIoU，铰接结构与位姿误差降低5-10倍，重建精度获得实质性提升。我们进一步展示了该方法在仿真URDF/USD导出、手部引导的供性映射以及机器人与场景交互等领域的应用。

title: A Co-Design Framework for High-Performance Jumping of a Five-Bar Monoped with Actuator Optimization
summary: The performance of legged robots depends strongly on both mechanical design and control, motivating co-design approaches that jointly optimize these parameters. However, most existing co-design studies focus on optimizing link dimensions and transmission ratios while neglecting detailed actuator design, particularly motor and gearbox parameter optimization, and are largely limited to serial open-chain mechanisms. In this work, we present a co-design framework for a planar closed-chain five-bar monoped that jointly optimizes mechanical design, motor and gearbox parameters, and control parameters for dynamic jumping. The objective is to maximize jump distance while minimizing mechanical energy consumption. The framework uses a two-stage optimization approach, where actuator optimization generates a mapping from gear ratio to actuator mass, efficiency, and peak torque, which is then used in co-design optimization of the robot design and control using CMA-ES. Simulation results show an improvement of approximately 42% in jump distance and a 15.8% reduction in mechanical energy consumption compared to a nominal design, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework in identifying optimal design, actuator, and control parameters for high-performance and energy-efficient planar jumping.
tldr: A co-design framework jointly optimizing the mechanical design, actuator parameters, and control for a planar five-bar monoped robot to maximize jump distance and minimize energy consumption, demonstrating significant performance improvements in simulation.
tldr_zh: 一个针对平面五杆单足机器人的协同设计框架，联合优化机械设计、执行器参数和控制，旨在最大化跳跃距离并最小化能耗，仿真结果表明性能显著提升。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
腿式机器人的性能在很大程度上依赖于机械设计与控制的协同优化，这推动了同时对这两类参数进行优化的协同设计方法。然而，现有的大多数协同设计研究主要关注优化连杆尺寸和传动比，而忽略了详细的驱动器设计，特别是电机和齿轮箱参数优化，且主要局限于串联开链机构。本研究提出了一种针对平面闭链五杆单足机器人的协同设计框架，该框架同时优化机械设计、电机与齿轮箱参数以及动态跳跃控制参数。目标是在最大化跳跃距离的同时，最小化机械能量消耗。该框架采用两阶段优化方法：首先通过驱动器优化生成齿轮比到驱动器质量、效率和峰值扭矩的映射关系，随后利用协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）对机器人设计与控制进行协同设计优化。仿真结果表明，与基准设计相比，该框架使跳跃距离提升约42%，机械能量消耗降低15.8%，验证了所提框架在识别高性能、高能效平面跳跃机器人最优设计、驱动器及控制参数方面的有效性。

title: Hazard Management in Robot-Assisted Mammography Support
summary: Robotic and embodied-AI systems have the potential to improve accessibility and quality of care in clinical settings, but their deployment in close physical contact with vulnerable patients introduces significant safety risks. This paper presents a hazard management methodology for MammoBot, an assistive robotic system designed to support patients during X-ray mammography. To ensure safety from early development stages, we combine stakeholder-guided process modelling with Software Hazard Analysis and Resolution in Design (SHARD) and System-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA). The robot-assisted workflow is defined collaboratively with clinicians, roboticists, and patient representatives to capture key human-robot interactions. SHARD is applied to identify technical and procedural deviations, while STPA is used to analyse unsafe control actions arising from user interaction. The results show that many hazards arise not from component failures, but from timing mismatches, premature actions, and misinterpretation of system state. These hazards are translated into refined and additional safety requirements that constrain system behaviour and reduce reliance on correct human timing or interpretation alone. The work demonstrates a structured and traceable approach to safety-driven design with potential applicability to assistive robotic systems in clinical environments.
tldr: This paper presents a structured hazard management methodology combining stakeholder modeling, SHARD, and STPA for a robot-assisted mammography support system, focusing on safety requirements from human-robot interaction. It demonstrates safety-driven design for assistive clinical robotics.
tldr_zh: 本研究为机器人辅助乳腺X光检查支持系统提出了一种结合利益相关者建模、SHARD和STPA的结构化危害管理方法，聚焦于人机交互产生的安全需求，展示了面向临床辅助机器人的安全驱动设计方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人与具身人工智能系统在临床环境中具备提升护理可及性与质量的潜力，但其在与脆弱患者近距离接触时部署会引发重大安全风险。本文提出了一种针对MammoBot辅助机器人系统的危险管理方法，该系统旨在为患者接受X射线乳腺摄影检查时提供支持。为确保从早期开发阶段的安全性，我们融合了利益相关者引导的过程建模、软件设计与危险分析解决（SHARD）以及系统理论过程分析（STPA）。通过与临床医生、机器人专家和患者代表共同协作，确定了机器人辅助工作流程，以捕捉关键的人机交互环节。应用SHARD识别技术与流程偏差，同时利用STPA分析由用户交互引发的非安全控制行为。研究结果表明，多数危险并非源于部件故障，而是由时序错配、过早操作及系统状态误判所导致。这些危险被转化为精细化的补充安全要求，用以约束系统行为并减少对单一正确人工时序或判断的依赖。本工作展示了一种结构化、可追溯的安全驱动设计方法，对临床环境中的辅助机器人系统具有潜在适用性。

title: Control Architecture and experimental validation of a Novel Surgical Robotic Instrument
summary: Minimally invasive surgery (MIS) reduces patient trauma and shortens recovery time; however, conventional laparoscopic instruments remain constrained by limited range of movements. This work presents the control architecture of a 4-DOF flexible laparoscopic instrument integrating distal bending, independent distal head rotation, shaft rotation, and a gripper, while maintaining a 10 mm diameter compatible with standard trocars. The actuation unit and SpaceMouse teleoperation are implemented on Raspberry Pi 5 with Motoron controllers. An analytical scissor-linkage model is derived and parameterized. The predicted jaw opening corresponds to CAD measurements (MAE 0.13{\textdegree}) and OptiTrack motion capture (MAE 1.43{\textdegree}). Integration with the ATHENA parallel robot is validated through a simulated pancreatic surgery procedure.
tldr: This paper presents a control architecture for a 4-DOF flexible surgical robotic instrument, including hardware implementation and kinematic modeling, validated in a simulated pancreatic surgery scenario.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于4自由度柔性手术机器人器械的控制架构，包括硬件实现和运动学建模，并通过模拟胰腺手术场景进行了验证。
summary_zh: 微创手术（MIS）能够减少患者创伤并缩短恢复时间；然而，传统腹腔镜器械仍受限于有限的活动范围。本研究提出一种4自由度柔性腹腔镜器械的控制架构，该器械集成了末端弯曲、独立的末端头旋转、轴体旋转和夹持器功能，同时保持10毫米直径，兼容标准穿刺器。驱动单元与SpaceMouse远程操作系统基于树莓派5及Motoron控制器实现。推导并参数化了一种解析式剪叉连杆模型，其预测的夹爪开合角度与CAD测量结果（平均绝对误差0.13°）及OptiTrack运动捕捉数据（平均绝对误差1.43°）吻合。通过模拟胰腺手术流程，验证了该器械与ATHENA并联机器人的集成性能。

title: Simulation-Driven Evolutionary Motion Parameterization for Contact-Rich Granular Scooping with a Soft Conical Robotic Hand
summary: Tool-based scooping is vital in robot-assisted tasks, enabling interaction with objects of varying sizes, shapes, and material states. Recent studies have shown that flexible, reconfigurable soft robotic end-effectors can adapt their shape to maintain consistent contact with container surfaces during scooping, improving efficiency compared to rigid tools. These soft tools can adjust to varying container sizes and materials without requiring complex sensing or control. However, the inherent compliance and complex deformation behavior of soft robotics introduce significant control complexity that limits practical applications. To address this challenge, this paper presents the development of a physics-based simulation model of a deformable soft conical robotic hand that captures its passive reconfiguration dynamics and enables systematic trajectory optimization for scooping tasks. We propose a novel physics-based simulation approach that accurately models the soft tool's morphing behavior from flat sheets to adaptive conical structures, combined with an evolutionary strategy framework that automatically optimizes scooping trajectories without manual parameter tuning. We validate the optimized trajectories through both simulation and real-robot experiments. The results demonstrate strong generalization and successfully address a range of challenging tasks previously beyond the reach of existing approaches. Videos of our experiments are available online: https://sites.google.com/view/scoopsh
tldr: This paper presents a physics-based simulation and evolutionary trajectory optimization method for controlling a soft conical robotic hand to perform granular scooping tasks, validated in both simulation and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于物理的仿真和进化轨迹优化方法，用于控制软锥形机器人手执行颗粒物铲取任务，并在仿真和真实机器人实验中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 基于工具的舀取在机器人辅助任务中至关重要，它使得机器人能够与不同尺寸、形状和材料状态的物体进行交互。最近的研究表明，灵活可重构的软体机器人末端执行器能够调整自身形状，在舀取过程中与容器表面保持持续接触，从而提高作业效率，相比刚性工具具有显著优势。这些软体工具能够适应不同容器尺寸和材料，无需复杂的传感或控制。然而，软体机器人固有的柔顺性和复杂变形行为引入了显著的控制复杂性，限制了其实际应用。为解决这一挑战，本文提出了一种基于物理的可变形软体锥形机械手仿真模型，该模型能够捕捉其被动重构动力学特性，并为舀取任务实现系统化的轨迹优化。我们提出了一种新颖的基于物理的仿真方法，精确模拟了软体工具从平面薄片到自适应锥形结构的形态变化行为，并结合进化策略框架，能够自动优化舀取轨迹，无需人工参数调整。我们通过仿真和真实机器人实验验证了优化后的轨迹。实验结果表明，该方法具有强大的泛化能力，并成功解决了以往方法难以应对的一系列挑战性任务。实验视频详见：https://sites.google.com/view/scoopsh

title: VLA-InfoEntropy: A Training-Free Vision-Attention Information Entropy Approach for Vision-Language-Action Models Inference Acceleration and Success
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action decision-making for cross-modal semantic alignment, exhibiting broad application potential. However, the joint processing of high-dimensional visual features, complex linguistic inputs, and continuous action sequences incurs significant computational overhead and low inference efficiency, thereby hindering real-time deployment and reliability. To address this issue, we use image entropy to quantify the grayscale distribution characteristics of each visual token and introduce attention entropy to capture the distribution of attention scores over task-related text. Visual entropy identifies texture-rich or structurally informative regions, while attention entropy pinpoints semantically relevant tokens. Combined with timestep information, these metrics enable a dynamic transition strategy that shifts the model's focus from global visual features to attention-guided local informative regions. Thus, the resulting VLA-InfoEntropy method integrates spatial, semantic, and temporal cues to reduce redundancy while preserving critical content. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces inference parameters, accelerates inference speed, and outperforms existing approaches.
tldr: This paper proposes a training-free method, VLA-InfoEntropy, to accelerate the inference of Vision-Language-Action models by dynamically focusing on informative image regions and text tokens based on entropy metrics and timestep information.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的方法VLA-InfoEntropy，通过基于熵度量和时间步信息动态聚焦于信息丰富的图像区域和文本令牌，以加速视觉-语言-行动模型的推理。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过整合视觉感知、语言理解与动作决策以实现跨模态语义对齐，展现出广泛的应用潜力。然而，高维视觉特征、复杂语言输入与连续动作序列的联合处理会产生显著的计算开销和较低的推理效率，从而阻碍了实时部署与可靠性。为解决这一问题，我们利用图像熵量化各视觉令牌的灰度分布特征，并引入注意力熵以捕捉与任务相关文本的注意力分数分布。视觉熵用于识别纹理丰富或结构信息密集的区域，而注意力熵则聚焦于语义相关的关键令牌。结合时间步信息，这些度量指标构建了一种动态转换策略，使模型能够从全局视觉特征逐步转向注意力引导下的局部信息区域。由此形成的VLA-InfoEntropy方法整合了空间、语义与时间线索，在保留关键内容的同时有效减少了冗余信息。大量实验表明，该方法在减少推理参数、提升推理速度方面均优于现有方法。

title: Staggered Integral Online Conformal Prediction for Safe Dynamics Adaptation with Multi-Step Coverage Guarantees
summary: Safety-critical control of uncertain, adaptive systems often relies on conservative, worst-case uncertainty bounds that limit closed-loop performance. Online conformal prediction is a powerful data-driven method for quantifying uncertainty when truth values of predicted outputs are revealed online; however, for systems that adapt the dynamics without measurements of the state derivatives, standard online conformal prediction is insufficient to quantify the model uncertainty. We propose Staggered Integral Online Conformal Prediction (SI-OCP), an algorithm utilizing an integral score function to quantify the lumped effect of disturbance and learning error. This approach provides long-run coverage guarantees, resulting in long-run safety when synthesized with safety-critical controllers, including robust tube model predictive control. Finally, we validate the proposed approach through a numerical simulation of an all-layer deep neural network (DNN) adaptive quadcopter using robust tube MPC, highlighting the applicability of our method to complex learning parameterizations and control strategies.
tldr: This paper introduces a new conformal prediction algorithm for safe, adaptive control, validated on a DNN-adaptive quadcopter simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的安全自适应控制保形预测算法，并在一个DNN自适应四旋翼飞行器仿真中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 摘要：针对不确定自适应系统的安全关键控制通常依赖于保守的、最坏情况下的不确定性边界，这限制了闭环性能。在线共形预测是一种强大的数据驱动方法，可在预测输出的真实值在线揭示时量化不确定性；然而，对于未测量状态导数而动态调整的系统，标准的在线共形预测不足以量化模型不确定性。我们提出交错积分在线共形预测（SI-OCP）算法，该算法利用积分评分函数来量化干扰与学习误差的综合效应。该方法提供长期覆盖保证，当与安全关键控制器（包括鲁棒管模型预测控制）结合时，能够实现长期安全性。最后，通过使用鲁棒管模型预测控制对全层深度神经网络（DNN）自适应四旋翼飞行器进行数值仿真，验证了所提方法的有效性，凸显了该方法在复杂学习参数化与控制策略中的适用性。

title: Automating Manual Tasks through Intuitive Robot Programming and Cognitive Robotics
summary: This paper presents a novel concept for intuitive end-user programming of robots, inspired by natural interaction between humans. Natural language and supportive gestures are translated into robot programs using large language models (LLMs) and computer vision (CV). Through equally natural system feedback in the form of clarification questions and visual representations, the generated program can be reviewed and adjusted, thereby ensuring safety, transparency, and user acceptance.
tldr: This paper presents an intuitive robot programming system using LLMs and computer vision to translate natural language and gestures into robot programs, with feedback for safety and user acceptance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种直观的机器人编程系统，利用大型语言模型和计算机视觉将自然语言和手势翻译成机器人程序，并通过反馈确保安全性和用户接受度。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向终端用户的直观机器人编程新概念，其灵感来源于人类自然交互行为。通过大型语言模型与计算机视觉技术，系统将自然语言及辅助手势转化为可执行的机器人程序。借助澄清式提问与可视化呈现等自然化的系统反馈机制，生成程序可被审查与调整，从而确保操作安全性、系统透明度及用户接受度。

title: Leaderless Collective Motion in Affine Formation Control over the Complex Plane
summary: We propose a method for the collective maneuvering of affine formations in the plane by modifying the original weights of the Laplacian matrix used to achieve static formations of robot swarms. Specifically, the resulting collective motion is characterized as a time-varying affine transformation of a reference configuration, or shape. Unlike the traditional leader-follower strategy, our leaderless scheme allows agents to maintain distinct and possibly time-varying velocities, enabling a broader range of collective motions, including all the linear combinations of translations, rotations, scaling and shearing of a reference shape. Our analysis provides the analytic solution governing the resulting collective motion, explicitly designing the eigenvectors and eigenvalues that define this motion as a function of the modified weights in the new Laplacian matrix. To facilitate a more tractable analysis and design of affine formations in 2D, we propose the use of complex numbers to represent all relevant information. Simulations with up to 20 agents validate the theoretical results.
tldr: This paper proposes a leaderless method for controlling the collective motion of robot swarms in 2D using modified Laplacian matrices, generating affine transformations like scaling and shearing of a reference shape, analyzed via complex number representation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种无领导者方法，通过修改拉普拉斯矩阵权重来控制二维机器人集群的集体运动，能够实现平移、旋转、缩放和剪切等仿射变换，并使用复数表示法进行分析。
summary_zh: 我们提出一种平面仿射编队集体机动方法，通过修改用于实现机器人集群静态编队的拉普拉斯矩阵原始权值实现。具体而言，所生成的集体运动可表征为参考构型（即形状）的时变仿射变换。不同于传统领导者-跟随者策略，我们的无领导者方案使智能体能够保持不同且可能时变的速度，从而实现更广泛的集体运动，包括参考形状的平移、旋转、缩放和剪切等所有线性组合。我们的分析提供了描述该集体运动的解析解，通过显式设计特征向量和特征值，将其定义为新拉普拉斯矩阵中修正权值的函数。为便于二维仿射编队进行更易处理的分析与设计，我们提出采用复数表示所有相关信息。针对最多20个智能体的仿真验证了理论结果。

title: Differentiable Invariant Sets for Hybrid Limit Cycles with Application to Legged Robots
summary: For hybrid systems exhibiting periodic behavior, analyzing the invariant set containing the limit cycle is a natural way to study the robustness of the closed-loop system. However, computing these sets can be computationally expensive, especially when applied to contact-rich cyber-physical systems such as legged robots. In this work, we extend existing methods for overapproximating reachable sets of continuous systems using parametric embeddings to compute a forward-invariant set around the nominal trajectory of a simplified model of a bipedal robot. Our three-step approach (i) computes an overapproximating reachable set around the nominal continuous flow, (ii) catalogs intersections with the guard surface, and (iii) passes these intersections through the reset map. If the overapproximated reachable set after one step is a strict subset of the initial set, we formally verify a forward invariant set for this hybrid periodic orbit. We verify this condition on the bipedal walker model numerically using immrax, a JAX-based library for parametric reachable set computation, and use it within a bi-level optimization framework to design a tracking controller that maximizes the size of the invariant set.
tldr: The paper presents a method for verifying forward-invariant sets for hybrid periodic orbits, specifically on a bipedal walker model, and uses this within a controller design framework to maximize robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种方法，用于验证混合周期轨道的前向不变集，特别是在双足步行机器人模型上，并利用该框架设计控制器以最大化鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 对于表现出周期性行为的混杂系统，分析包含极限环的不变集是研究闭环系统鲁棒性的自然方法。然而，计算这些集合的计算成本可能很高，尤其是在应用于足式机器人等接触密集的信息物理系统时。本文中，我们将现有的基于参数化嵌入的连续系统可达集过近似方法进行扩展，用以计算双足机器人简化模型标称轨迹周围的前向不变集。我们的三步法包括：（1）计算标称连续流周围的可达集过近似；（2）记录其与守卫曲面的交集；（3）将这些交集通过重置映射传递。若一步过近似后的可达集是初始集的严格子集，则我们可形式化验证该混杂周期轨道的前向不变集。我们在双足步行器模型上使用基于JAX的可达集参数化计算库immrax对该条件进行数值验证，并将其应用于双层优化框架中，以设计出能够最大化不变集尺寸的跟踪控制器。

title: Intuitive Human-Robot Interaction: Development and Evaluation of a Gesture-Based User Interface for Object Selection
summary: Gestures are a natural form of communication between humans and can also be leveraged for human-robot interaction. This work presents a gesture-based user interface for object selection using pointing and click gestures. An experiment with 20 participants evaluates accuracy and selection time, demonstrating the potential for efficient collaboration.
tldr: This paper presents a gesture-based interface for human-robot interaction using pointing and clicking for object selection, evaluated through a user study measuring accuracy and selection time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于手势的人机交互界面，利用指向和点击手势进行对象选择，并通过用户实验评估了其准确性和选择时间。
summary_zh: 手势是人类之间自然的交流方式，也可应用于人机交互领域。本研究提出一种基于手势的用户界面，通过指向与点击手势实现目标选取功能。一项包含20名参与者的实验评估了该系统的准确性与选择时间，结果证实了其促进高效协作的潜力。

title: Dynamic Control Allocation for Dual-Tilt UAV Platforms
summary: This paper focuses on dynamic control allocation for a hexarotor UAV platform, considering a trajectory tracking task as as case study. It is assumed that the platform is dual-tilting, meaning that it is able to tilt each propeller independently during flight, along two orthogonal axis. We present a hierarchical control structure composed of a high-level controller generating the required wrench for the tracking task, and a control allocation law ensuring that the actuators produce such wrench. The allocator imposes desired first-order dynamics on the actuators set, and exploits system redundancy to optimize the actuators state with respect to a given objective function. Unlike other studies on the subject, we explicitly model actuator saturation and provide theoretical insights on its effect on control performances.
